SIKAGRIND®-272: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrind®-272, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sikagrind_-272.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrind®-272 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrind®-272 is a chloride free, cement and slag liquid additive.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increase the strength development of cement
    - Improve the production rate of the cement and slag grinding system

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrind®-272
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Grinding Aid and Quality Improver for the production of cement and slag
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. SikaGrind®-272 is produced under Quality management systems according to EN ISO 9001.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrind®-272 is a dispersant with the following characteristics:
    - Chemical activation of the hydration process (cement)
    - Neutralisation of electrical charges on the surface of the particles
    - Separation of the cement or slag particles
    - Enhanced grinding performance of the mill
    - Higher separator efficiency
    - Higher mill output (tons per hour)
    - Reduced relative power consumption per ton of material
    - Easier achievement of the desired binder fineness (Blaine, particle fraction > 45µm, grain size distribution)
    - Reduced quantity of “over-milled” particles in the binder grading
    - Increased strength development especially at early ages
    - Earlier set time characteristics
    - Economic cement design with clinker replacements
    SikaGrind®-272 provides the following advantages in the cement and slag production:
    SikaGrind®-272 gives the following advantages to the finished cement:
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of amino alcohols
    - Appearance and colour: Brown liquid
    - Density: 1.07 ± 0.02 kg/l (at +20°C)
    - pH-Value: 8.0 ± 1.0
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1000 kg IBC; Bulk deliveries
    - Shelf life: At least 12 months in undamaged, unopened and sealed original containers.
2.7 Storage conditions. Stored at temperatures between +5°C and +35°C. Protect from frost, direct sunlight and contamination. Note: When delivered in bulk, the tanks and equipment used must be free from contaminants. Material compatibility: Storage and transport in stainless steel or plastic containers (such as polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), rigid PVC).

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage rates of SikaGrind®-272 are between 0.3 - 0.6 kg per ton of cement or slag (0.03% - 0.06% of total weight = cement clinker + additions or simply slag). The optimum dosage to achieve the desired characteristics shall be determined in plant trials. Influencing factors are e.g. the properties of clinker, type of cement, hardness of the slag and other plant variables. For consistent results, SikaGrind®-272 must be accurately dispensed (see the section Dispensing).
4.3 Dispensing. SikaGrind®-272 shall be added onto the clinker feed shortly before the mill entrance or directly into the grinding mill (first or second compartment). Suitable dosage pumps with adjustable flow rates shall be used for accurate dosing. Note: Periodically, the end of the additive tube/hose shall be checked to ensure that it is not blocked.
4.4 Compatibility. Cements treated with SikaGrind®-272 are compatible in concretes produced with all commercial admixtures including air entrainers, water reducers, retarders and superplasticizers. The performance of concrete admixtures is not adversely affected by the use of SikaGrind®-272.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrind®-272, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sikagrind_-272.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaGrind 272, version 12/10/2021, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/SikaGrind%20272%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGrind®-272, version 16/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sds-sikagrind-272.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
